attributes.name: utf8
attributes.digest: UTF-8 Output
attributes.description: Thesets the output mode of; when enabled, the numbers output, characters in the input are represented using UTF-8 encoding. When disabled, Unicode characters are represented using UTF-32. Whenis enabled, the size of the output list of character codes may be larger than the number of characters in the input. For characters with codes below 127 (ASCII) there is no difference between UTF-8 and UTF-32 encoding.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: In left inlet: The character code value of each letter, digit, or other character in the symbol is stored internally and sent out the outlet as a list.In middle inlet: The character code value of each letter, digit, or other character in the symbol is appended to the currently stored list. No output is triggered.In right inlet: The character code value of each letter, digit, or other character in the symbol is stored internally, replacing the previously stored list, but not output.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: amessage can be used to trigger the output of the currently stored numerical list. Ain the right two inlets is treated as a symbol.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: In left inlet: Themessage is used to clear the contents of the internally-stored numerical list. The wordin the right two inlets is treated as a symbol.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Convert a number to character code representation
messages.description: In left inlet: The character code value of each of the digits of the number is stored internally and sent out the outlet as a list.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Convert a number to character code representation
messages.description: In left inlet: The character code value of each of the digits of the number is stored internally and sent out the outlet as a list.

messages.name: list
messages.description: Each int in the list is converted to a character code as described above, and a space character (ASCII value 32) is inserted between items in the list. The middle inlet is used to append to the currently stored list, and the right inlet will set the contents of the internally stored list, without causing output.
